description: This file defines the 'Relationship' class within the SuiteCRM JSON API resource namespace, handling resource relationships including setting relationship names, types, and converting relationship data to JSON API responses.

classes.name: Relationship
classes.description: Represents a resource relationship in the JSON API, supporting relationship type management and JSON serialization.

methods.name: setRelationshipName
methods.description: Sets the name of the relationship.

methods.name: getRelationshipName
methods.description: Returns the name of the relationship.

methods.name: getRelationshipType
methods.description: Returns the type of the relationship (to-one or to-many).

methods.name: setRelationshipType
methods.description: Sets the relationship type, throws exception if unsupported type.

methods.name: withResourceIdentifier
methods.description: Associates a ResourceIdentifier with this relationship and returns a clone.

methods.name: toJsonApiResponse
methods.description: Converts the relationship to a JSON API response format.

methods.name: withResourceObject
methods.description: Internal method to set up the link property with a related resource object.
